desc: The Zastava VUK Titanium AK Suppressor is purpose-built for AK-platform rifles, delivering top-tier performance while maintaining a lightweight design. Made entirely from titanium, it offers exceptional durability without unnecessary weight. Featuring Purposely Induced Porosity (PIP) technology, this suppressor enhances structural strength, improves heat dissipation, and reduces backpressure, resulting in a smoother shooting experience. Measuring 8.3 inches in length and weighing just 13.4 ounces, the VUK is full-auto rated, making it a reliable choice for high-volume shooting. It attaches directly via a 14x1mm left-hand thread, ensuring a secure and straightforward installation. Optimized for 7.62x39mm, it can also handle smaller calibers with similar case capacities. Finished with a high-temperature Cerakote coating, the VUK suppressor is designed to withstand harsh conditions while delivering superior sound suppression. Engineered specifically for AK enthusiasts, it provides a balance of durability, reduced gas blowback, and enhanced overall performance.
